_comment: Carry destination for issue #1541's fix stage (the round-8 fix group for #1541 (non-finite values published outside sensor.py), inside R8-P1 in the round-8 fix plan). No roster group in this tree claims #1541; the round-8 wave roster is not landed yet, so this file is that stage's brief until one does, and the roster that claims #1541 must absorb it (brief_lint refuses two destinations). stage: the round-8 fix group for #1541 (non-finite values published outside sensor.py), inside R8-P1 in the round-8 fix plan

carries.from: PR #1551, the round-8 audit register, carrying the round-8 judge's instrument notes (tools/audit/round8/JUDGE.json, instrument_notes; tools/audit/round8/JUDGE.md) at fix review round 2
carries.control: The assumption invalidated: that tools/audit/round8/D8/s1_finite_boundary.py measures serialisation failure. orjson was not installed in the audit environment and is not in the round's BASELINE.md pins, so the harness fell back to a stub that counts every non-finite float as a serialisation failure. The judge installed real orjson 3.12.0 into a private --target directory and re-ran: real orjson writes NaN and Inf as null, climate_leaks read 0 with it on the path against 1 through the fallback. That separation is the control. #1541 was weakened from high to low on it.
carries.remeasure: Run the harness with real orjson importable (a private pip --target directory on PYTHONPATH, never the shared environment, and not from the repository root: pip download writes into the cwd) at your merge base and at your head, and print which orjson the harness imported. A run on the stub is not evidence.
carries.brief: The defect left is the in-process value templates read, not a serialisation crash: judge a fix on whether climate, switch, binary_sensor and datetime publish finite values in process, measured with real orjson on the path. Harnesses are not in the tree: restore them from transport commit 6f58e33e as the round-8 register section 'What this commit does not carry' in docs/audit-2026-09.md says, so every tools/audit/round8/D3/... path below resolves.
